subject: Acme Health — SDK clinic & local sandbox setup: post-call notes and next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acme Health — SDK clinic & local sandbox setup: post-call notes and next steps

Hi team,

Quick recap from this morning's discovery with Kate and Samir at Acme Health (recording linked in HubSpot). High-level: they want to embed LLM-powered triage + search into their provider portal. Primary constraints: PHI (so Private deployment or strict VPC controls), strict audit logging, and SSO with their Okta instance.

Key technical asks we captured:
- SDK quickstart for Python + TS showing auth flow (API key -> token exchange for short-lived creds)
- Example for embeddings indexing patient notes + a reranker flow for search results
- Structured tool calling example (lab-ordering stub) to show deterministic outputs
- Local sandbox: minimal sample app + smoke tests to run on dev machines (no PHI in sample data)
- SSO metadata + SAML/SCIM hints for their security team

Proposed internal owners / next steps:
- Marissa: produce a compact SDK quickstart repo (Python + TS) + sandbox smoke-tests doc. Include example embedding pipeline and a reranker sample. Attachments: sample app + test checklist. Target: EOD Tue (2027-08-03).
- Ben: lead pricing/next-step commercial ask and schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with their infra/security team. Proposed window: Thu/Fri (see below).
- Lauren (me): coordinate SSO/PII constraints with security & get the dedicated/private deployment T-shirt sizing (gpu count / SLA assumptions).

Immediate asks from Kate: schedule a 1-hour technical session that includes their security engineer and an internal dev. She asked for a hands-on repo she can run locally before the call.

I marked HubSpot HS-9271342 with the required follow-ups and added the recording + transcript. Attaching the runbook stub I used during the call.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of GTM Engineering, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
(Attachment: runbook-acme-postcall.md)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kate Morgan <kate@acmehealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-08-01T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme Health — SDK clinic & local sandbox setup: post-call notes and next steps

Thanks Lauren — copying Kate so we can align on the sandbox expectations.

Kate / Samir: good to meet you today. I've sketched a short "dev clinic" deliverable:
1) A tiny repo (acme-sdk-sampleapp.zip) with two folders: /python and /ts. Each contains:
   - minimal auth example (API key exchange -> short-lived token)
   - embedding indexer (sample documents) using Redwood embeddings endpoint
   - simple reranker example (score reordering on top-k)
   - README with commands for local run (no external PHI)
2) sandbox-smoke-tests.md — checklist to validate environment (node/Python versions, env vars, run smoke/test-suite.sh)
3) acme-auth-sso-metadata.xml — placeholder SAML metadata to show where they paste their Okta data (we will not ship real metadata until contract).

Notes on auth/routing:
- For the local quickstart, we'll include an auth shim that mints short-lived tokens against Redwood Hosted (to avoid embedding customer keys in sample code). For Private deployment customers we will include comments showing where to swap to the VPC endpoint and KMS config.
- Routing: include example config for pinning requests to a low-latency region (us-west) and fallback to a lower-cost model variant.
- Structured outputs: add a small tool-calling example showing a lab-ordering JSON schema and how to validate outputs with assertions in the sample tests.

I'll push the zip + docs to the Drive link and update HS-9271342 with the repo snapshot. Target: initial push by 2027-08-03 17:00 PDT.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: acme-sdk-sampleapp.zip, sandbox-smoke-tests.md, acme-auth-sso-metadata.xml)

Kate — are you available for a 60-minute deep-dive on either:
  • Thu 2027-08-05 10:00–11:00 PT or

I will invite our security lead if you confirm. Agenda: quick demo of the sample app, run the smoke tests together, and go through SSO/SCIM questions.
